description: This file defines IPC message handling classes and types within the WPEFramework Core namespace, including scalar types, text, and buffer types, with external dependencies on Module.h, Portability.h, and Frame.h.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Template class for scalar types, specialized for string, providing serialization and assignment functionalities.

classes.name: ScalarType<string>
classes.description: Specialization of ScalarType for string type, includes serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Template class for fixed-length text handling, supporting copying, assignment, and serialization.

classes.name: BufferType
classes.description: Template class for buffer management, providing serialization, deserialization, and buffer manipulation.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for ScalarType and Text classes.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a byte buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte buffer into the object.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the stored scalar or string value.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the text or data.
